heading: You've already paid for the game. And the band. Most nights, that spend is invisible.
subhead: Broadcast packages are a fixed monthly or per-event cost, whether three fans watch or three hundred. Musicians and comedians get paid the same whether the room's half-empty or rammed. Most venues only manage to activate that spend on the one day it barely needs the help.

contrast.title: Already full
contrast.text: The room's busy either way — word of mouth, habit, a big fixture. Audeohost adds atmosphere here, not attendance. Nice, but it isn't where the growth is.

contrast.title: Already paid for. Empty anyway.
contrast.text: Three fans, house music, a screen nobody can actually hear. Same broadcast line-item as Saturday. Zero extra cost to give those three real commentary — and a reason for the next three to start showing up too.

beatStrip: You can't fill an already-full room. You can turn the nights it's empty into a reason to come back — using sport and entertainment you've already paid for, no matter what night it falls on.
